notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 67-year-old male admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.69, creatinine 0.8, hemoglobin 14.1, platelets 209, sodium 138, wbc 9.1; vitals dbp 73-77, heart_rate 80-84, map 93-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 131-138, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.82, hemoglobin 14.1, platelets 206, sodium 138, wbc 9.1; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 82-84, map 93-98, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 13-15, sbp 132-139, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 67-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
